scope: Whole-FFN architecture redesign: two L stages, producer-local GeGLU, L-owned down clusters, F32 stage and cluster reduction.
methods_selected: E74: BF16 activation, FP4-to-FP8 materialization, streamed BF16 lookup/DPE and compact F32 block partials
ffn-geglu-two-cluster: producer-local GeGLU with preserved global-scale BF16 boundaries and erf expression
C04/E79: ring32 leader broadcast mechanism, with a new two-column down mapping
methods_removed: E104 activation E5M2 three-term quantizer and native FP8 contraction
Full-L up/gate gather and single-cluster GeGLU
Down clusters owning H halves and requiring cross-cluster activation replication
Down waiting for the complete L=15360 GeGLU vector
graph: BF16 RMS input -> replicated TRF -> [stage 0: up/gate L[0:7680] -> local GeGLU -> down F32 partial] and [stage 1: up/gate L[7680:15360] -> local GeGLU -> down F32 partial] -> stage/cluster F32 sum -> BF16 -> global scale -> unchanged RMS/residual/layer scale

layout.producer: Dummy2=logical L-high cluster; slice=TileL/16%240#256; local=TileL%16; l=stage*7680+cluster*3840+slice*16+row
layout.down: Dummy2=logical L-high cluster; slice=(h/30, TileL/1920%2); local=(h%30, TileL%1920)
layout.final: Gather only F32 H partials; sum two stages and two L clusters before first down BF16 cast

prior_related: Two-cluster GeGLU alone increased down redistribution 9392->28648 static cycles while retaining H-owned down clusters
C05/E73 repeated lookup within small row tiles regressed on NPU; this prototype uses six large dot streams, not per-scale-tile lookup
C09/C11 are local changes, not evidence against this full-FFN dependency/ownership redesign
difference: Both producer and consumer layouts change together. Each stage's down consumes its own GeGLU output without another stage's completion. Down weight/scales are sliced in HBM preserving original pitches and loaded once per useful element.
new_costs: Six large weight decode/dot streams instead of three
Two sets of producer-local GeGLU/scale operations
Stage and cross-cluster F32 output gather/reduction
Strided HBM down tiles and changed down broadcast/fanout
stop_condition: One full prototype and at most one clear API/shape correction. Close on unsupported redistribution/reduction, a schedule retaining the whole-L dependency, repeated weight loads, or a clear total-cost regression without a compensating architectural benefit. Small static differences alone do not reject the family. Arena requires coherent compiled graph and correctness; screen against actual E104 package.
api_shape_correction: Only reorder HBM split/rename before tile; the compiler rejects reshaping an already tiled HBM view. Preserve all original row pitches via Stage=1#2. Same graph, arithmetic and ownership as v1.

bounded_gate_exception.reason: v2 failed before arithmetic lowering because a shared TileL axis crosses a non-power-of-two cluster boundary plus physical slice padding. E74 already compiles the separate Dummy2 cluster + padded low-L mapping. One final representational correction uses that proven form, preserving the complete graph, ownership, pitches and arithmetic.
bounded_gate_exception.scope: Split full HBM views into Stage x Dummy2 x low TileL before tiling; carry Dummy2 to the final F32 cluster reduction.
bounded_gate_exception.after_failure: Close this prototype without further fixes or tile sweeps; no family-wide performance conclusion.
